mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper identifies etamycin as a streptogramin B depsipeptide and discusses protein-synthesis inhibition as a presumed class mechanism, not as a directly measured molecular target in this study.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No ribosome-binding or translation assay was performed for etamycin in this paper; do not promote this to direct_mechanism.
